//: STRICT TYPE-CHECK GATE FOR THE EXECUTIVE / CORPORATE DASHBOARD TREE.
The root `tsconfig.json` is a Vite-style solution stub (`files: []` plus
project references). Running `npx tsc --noEmit` therefore compiled ZERO files
and always exited 0, and `next build` skipped type checking entirely.
That vacuous pass is precisely why `ExecutiveDashboardShell` could ship with
a bare `loading` identifier (TS2304 'Cannot find name') - a fatal
ReferenceError that took down all three executive dashboards at render time
while every gate in the pipeline still reported green.
This config type checks the dashboard tree for real. It inherits the app
which are style rules, not correctness rules - the dashboard files carry a
handful of harmless unused imports (TS6133) that would otherwise mask real
errors. Everything that can actually break at runtime is still checked:
undefined names, wrong argument/return types, missing properties, and
Run it with:  npm run typecheck
